zh-CN.title: 全新的照片与视频预览
items: 聊天、广场和外链统一使用媒体 Drawer，可以滑动切换照片和视频，展开查看拍摄信息。
上传前可逐张裁剪照片、调整角度、打马赛克、应用滤镜，并选择保留的位置和说明。

en.title: A new photo and video viewer
items: Chat, Square, and external links now share a media drawer with swipe navigation, video controls, and photo details.
Crop, straighten, pixelate, or apply filters to each photo before uploading. Choose whether to keep its location and caption.
